text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This happened shortly before
the summer training camp began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After reading the same article over and over again,
Yamanin Zephyr
then muttered in a trembling voice.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ......No way, that can't be.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Will you... not make it in time?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san is... for the Kikuka Sho...
choice_data_list: ...That seems to be what the diagnosis says.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That's—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Diagnosed with a bone fracture; six months until full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having conquered the Japanese Derby undefeated and standing poised to claim the Triple Crown, a heartless verdict was handed down to Tokai Teio—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The path to conquering the Kikuka-sho has collapsed."
As reported day after day, a month after the announcement, expectations had completely turned into grief...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Ah, so chillingly bleak... quiet, lonely, and dark.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (It's as if people's tears have seeped into the atmosphere, making it heavy with sorrow—)

Huh, Zephyr?
What's wrong, why the long face?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: !? T-Teio-san!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Um, your legs... your body...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, about that?
...No need to worry, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: As you can see, the cast is completely off, and I've been hitting rehab hard.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it in time for the Kikuka Sho, no matter what!
That goes without saying, right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: B-But... it'll take six full months to recover, right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The summer storm blows only in early summer.
To make it blow in autumn is simply out of the question..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's impossible, I'll do it.
...I'll do it *because* it's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"The wall is high, and the road is steep.
But I knew all of that right from the very beginning."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, and yet I still aimed for it!
The 'Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume'!
The 'Emperor' who surpasses the 'Kaiser'!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm not going to stop
in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm going forward. Toward my dream, at full speed!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san... You are—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Putting that aside, Zephyr,
are you really running in the Sprinters Stakes next?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's a GⅠ!
Show me your cool side, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since you're working hard with the same feelings,
I'm actually cheering you on quite a bit!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Ah, how strange. Even though the sky is so heavily clouded over—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Teio-san. Coming from you... is a deeply warm, sun-drenched scent.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (This should be... impossible, and yet—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the summer training camp, Yamanin Zephyr had a bright and cheerful look on her face, as if her worries from the other day were just an illusion.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I talked with Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And... I felt deeply ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
At myself... for being overwhelmed by Ruby-san's spirit, and terrified of Helios-san's bottomless potential.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The wall is high, and the road is steep.
It took me a little while to realize it—
but deep down, I certainly knew it all along."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Could that cherished dream I yearned for so deeply
ever be reached so easily?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However, even if that were so—
No matter what.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Once a tempest has been unleashed within this heart, could anyone ever hope to calm it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Please train me.
Make me strong and sharp enough to withstand even the fiercest storm.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I want to move forward too.
Toward my dream, at full speed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Summer with Yamanin Zephyr begins.
